decisions.reason: Launched only in 2024 as a multi-model line that builds on core precast automation competence, its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open rather than being abandoned early, though the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows management does prune options.

Production analysis software is cheap to keep on the market, complements the firm's control systems and service offering, and its value from digital plant optimization is still unfolding, so retaining this low-cost option is justified.
